title: A part held by a 3 mm tab on 18 mm stock, with wheels on it
rationale: The closing cut leaves a 20 mm tab 3 mm thick. With the default t_hold = T/2 = 9 mm a 15 mm deep groove breaks holding material (safety-model 7.4), so the part is detached and the wheels on it are M-ATTACH. RT20-fact runs the same job with the R-TABS fact.
